title: Todoist Overdue Task Backlog
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=todoist:task
| where overdue="true"
| stats count as overdue_tasks by project
| where overdue_tasks>0
| sort - overdue_tasks
description: Uses Todoist task exports telemetry to monitor how many overdue tasks have accumulated by project in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for work buckets that are quietly becoming stale, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Todoist task exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Project table of overdue task counts.
grandmaExplanation: It records how many overdue tasks have accumulated by project so you can spot work buckets that are quietly becoming stale before it becomes annoying.
